result.summary: Several layout and clipping issues: truncated restaurant names, cut-off category pills, and partially visible cards indicate overflow/horizontal scroll problems that hurt readability and polish.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off in the Fastest near you row, so the full name is not readable.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size on small cards, or ensure the horizontal scroller fully reveals names without clipping mid-word.

issues.description: Category filter chips are cut off on the right (Healthy is partial and another pill is barely visible), suggesting overflow without a clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add proper horizontal scrolling with padding/fade, or wrap/resize chips so all labels remain fully visible.

issues.description: The third Fastest near you card is only partially on-screen, making the section feel unfinished and harder to browse.
issues.suggestion: Tighten card widths/gaps or show a clearer peek of the next card so users understand they can scroll.

issues.description: The bottom Popular item (pizza) is heavily cropped by the bottom nav, so key promo content is hard to see without scrolling.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding above the tab bar so cards aren’t obscured when the section comes into view.

issues.description: Delivery time badges sit over food images with soft contrast on light plates, which can reduce legibility.
issues.suggestion: Increase badge opacity/shadow or use a consistent high-contrast pill style on all cards.
